name: Monk
description: Monks use rigorous combat training and mental discipline to align themselves with the multiverse and focus their internal reservoirs of power.

weapons: Martial weapons with the Light property

1.name: Martial Arts
1.description:
Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use your Unarmed Strike and Monk weapons.
Bonus Unarmed Strike: Make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.
Martial Arts Die: Roll 1d6 in place of normal damage.
Dexterous Attacks: Use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls of Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons.

1.name: Unarmored Defense
1.description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

2.name: Monk's Focus
2.description: You have a well of extraordinary energy represented by Focus Points equal to your Monk level. You can use Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind.

2.name: Unarmored Movement
2.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

2.name: Uncanny Metabolism
2.description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended Focus Points. Roll your Martial Arts die and regain Hit Points equal to your Monk level plus the number rolled.

3.name: Deflect Attacks
3.description: When an attack roll hits you and deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level. If you reduce it to 0, you can expend 1 Focus Point to redirect it.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

4.name: Slow Fall
4.description: Take a Reaction when you fall to reduce fall damage by five times your Monk level.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

5.name: Stunning Strike
5.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a Monk weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 1 Focus Point to attempt a stunning strike. Target must make a Constitution save or be Stunned.

6.name: Empowered Strikes
6.description: Whenever you deal damage with your Unarmed Strike, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

6.name: Subclass Feature
6.description: You gain a feature from your Monk subclass.

7.name: Evasion
7.description: When subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
8.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice.

9.name: Acrobatic Movement
9.description: While unarmored, you gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling.

10.name: Heightened Focus
10.description: Flurry of Blows makes three strikes. Patient Defense grants Temporary Hit Points. Step of the Wind lets you bring a willing creature with you.

10.name: Self-Restoration
10.description: At the end of your turns, you can remove one condition: Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned. Forgoing food/drink doesn't cause Exhaustion.

11.name: Subclass Feature
11.description: You gain a feature from your Monk subclass.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
12.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice.

13.name: Deflect Energy
13.description: You can use Deflect Attacks against attacks that deal any damage type.

14.name: Disciplined Survivor
14.description: You gain proficiency in all saving throws. You can expend 1 Focus Point to reroll a failed save.

15.name: Perfect Focus
15.description: When you roll Initiative and don't use Uncanny Metabolism, you regain expended Focus Points until you have 4 if you have 3 or fewer.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
16.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice.

17.name: Subclass Feature
17.description: You gain a feature from your Monk subclass.

18.name: Superior Defense
18.description: At the start of your turn, you can expend 3 Focus Points to gain Resistance to all damage except Force damage for 1 minute.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice.

20.name: Body and Mind
20.description: Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

subclasses.name: Warrior of Mercy
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of Mercy learn to manipulate the life force of others to bring aid to those in need and to end the suffering of their enemies.

subclasses.name: Warrior of Shadow
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of Shadow value the arts of stealth and subterfuge, often serving as spies and assassins.

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Elements
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of the Elements draw on the elemental forces of the multiverse to enhance their attacks and defenses.

subclasses.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed.
